description_for_human: Resolve SharePoint links, run exhaustive data-room scans, and fetch IRL gap reports.
description_for_model: Deterministic tools for scanning a SharePoint-hosted virtual data room. resolveDrive turns a pasted SharePoint URL into a drive id. startScan launches the server-side enumeration and classification loop and returns immediately. reconcile reports coverage accounting (done + error must equal enumerated; complete=true means the scan is finished and provable). gapReport returns the IRL gap analysis and a markdown report. Never fabricate results; these tools are the only source of truth about the data room.

functions.name: resolveDrive
functions.description: Resolve a pasted SharePoint site, library, or folder URL to its backing Graph drive. Call this first whenever the user provides a link. Returns driveId and the library display name to confirm back to the user.

functions.name: startScan
functions.description: Start or resume the server-side scan (enumeration + classification) for a drive. Returns immediately with 'started' or 'already-running' plus a reconciliation snapshot.

functions.name: reconcile
functions.description: Get the coverage accounting for the current scan: enumerated, pending, done, error, removed, and complete. The scan is finished only when complete is true.

functions.name: gapReport
functions.description: Get the IRL gap analysis over the classified inventory: hard gaps, weak-evidence items, satisfied items, unmapped files, errored files, and a rendered markdown report. Only meaningful once reconcile reports complete.
